instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih06_stair_landing_seed.dxf. Complete the hard stair and landing detail. Draw STAIR rectangles (0,0)-(1800,1500) and (1800,0)-(3600,1500). Add eleven vertical tread divider lines at x=0,180,360,540,720,900,1080,1260,1440,1620,1800 from y=0 to y=1500. Add HANDRAIL lines (0,1300)-(3600,1300) and (0,200)-(3600,200). Add ARROW lines (350,750)-(1550,750) and (2050,750)-(3300,750), then add labels UP, LANDING, 10R @ 170, HANDRAIL BOTH SIDES, and 3600. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih06_stair_landing_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
